table_keys_help: Arrow keys move between cells. Enter edits a cell and Escape leaves it. On the name of a card, Space picks the row up to move it. On the heading of a column, Enter opens its menu and Space picks the column up to move it.
table_row_cancelled: Moving {item} was cancelled. It is back at row {position} of {count}.
table_column_picked_up: Picked up the {item} column. Column {position} of {count}.
table_column_dropped: Dropped the {item} column at place {position} of {count}.
table_column_cancelled: Moving the {item} column was cancelled. It is back at place {position} of {count}.
